title.zh: 修订第638号法案第2条。该法案授权并指示民政总督任命电气工程师和水利工程师，拟订将拉拉古纳省Majayjay附近Botocan瀑布水力转化为电力并输送至马尼拉市的计划和规格；本法案另规定勘测Caliraya河与Lomot河瀑布及周边地区
title.en: AN ACT TO AMEND SECTION TWO OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT, ENTITLED "AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE CIVIL GOVERNOR TO APPOINT AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER AND A HYDRAULIC ENGINEER FOR THE PURPOSE OF PREPARING PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE CONVERSION OF THE WATER POWER AT THE BOTOCAN WATERFALL, IN THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA, NEAR MAJAYJAY, INTO ELECTRICAL CURRENT TO BE CONVEYED TO THE CITY OF MANILA," BY PROVIDING FOR THE ADDITIONAL SURVEY OF THE FALLS OF THE RIVERS CALIRAYA AND LOMOT AND THE SURROUNDING COUNTRY.
title.orig: AN ACT TO AMEND SECTION TWO OF ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY-EIGHT, ENTITLED "AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND DIRECTING THE CIVIL GOVERNOR TO APPOINT AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER AND A HYDRAULIC ENGINEER FOR THE PURPOSE OF PREPARING PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS FOR THE CONVERSION OF THE WATER POWER AT THE BOTOCAN WATERFALL, IN THE PROVINCE OF LA LAGUNA, NEAR MAJAYJAY, INTO ELECTRICAL CURRENT TO BE CONVEYED TO THE CITY OF MANILA," BY PROVIDING FOR THE ADDITIONAL SURVEY OF THE FALLS OF THE RIVERS CALIRAYA AND LOMOT AND THE SURROUNDING COUNTRY.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều 2 của Đạo luật số 638, có nội dung cho phép và chỉ thị Thống đốc Dân sự bổ nhiệm kỹ sư điện và kỹ sư thủy lực để lập kế hoạch, thông số chuyển thủy năng tại thác Botocan gần Majayjay, tỉnh La Laguna, thành điện truyền đến Manila; đồng thời quy định khảo sát bổ sung các thác trên sông Caliraya và Lomot cùng khu vực xung quanh
title.th: กฎหมายแก้ไขมาตรา 2 ของกฎหมายเลขที่ 638 ซึ่งให้อำนาจและสั่งการให้ผู้ว่าการฝ่ายพลเรือนแต่งตั้งวิศวกรไฟฟ้าและวิศวกรชลศาสตร์เพื่อจัดทำแผนและข้อกำหนดในการเปลี่ยนพลังน้ำจากน้ำตกโบโตกันใกล้เมืองมาจายเจย์ จังหวัดลาลากูนา เป็นกระแสไฟฟ้าส่งไปยังกรุงมะนิลา และกำหนดให้สำรวจน้ำตกของแม่น้ำคาลิรายาและโลมอตกับพื้นที่โดยรอบเพิ่มเติม
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengubah Pasal 2 Undang-Undang Nomor 638, yang memberi wewenang dan memerintahkan Gubernur Sipil menunjuk insinyur listrik dan insinyur hidraulik untuk menyusun rencana serta spesifikasi pengubahan tenaga air di Air Terjun Botocan dekat Majayjay, Provinsi La Laguna, menjadi listrik untuk disalurkan ke Manila; juga mengatur survei tambahan atas air terjun di Sungai Caliraya dan Lomot serta daerah sekitarnya
title.ms: Akta meminda Seksyen 2 Akta No. 638, yang membenarkan dan mengarahkan Gabenor Sivil melantik jurutera elektrik dan jurutera hidraulik untuk menyediakan pelan serta spesifikasi bagi menukar kuasa air di Air Terjun Botocan berhampiran Majayjay, Wilayah La Laguna, kepada elektrik untuk disalurkan ke Manila; turut memperuntukkan tinjauan tambahan air terjun di Sungai Caliraya dan Lomot serta kawasan sekitarnya

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Six hundred and thirty-eight is hereby amended by adding at the
end thereof the following: "Said engineers shall also make a complete and comprehensive survey and map of
the falls of the Caliraya River and the Lomot River and the surrounding country, and report on the feasibility
of diverting the Lomot River by canals to the Caliraya River, and report on the conditions and possibilities of
these rivers, as directed in the first paragraph of this section, regarding the falls of the Botocan River."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 26, 1903.
